title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-114} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-22 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` equals `412752508724354725485854545197876683346123254355678047/2366317321637068800`, which is strictly greater than `2^{114}*(319/100) = 1656342697872610013501228329021210624/25`.
- The degree-21 partial sum is strictly below that target, and the next Taylor term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-114}`. This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below that majorant, hence strictly below `2^{-114}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is the case `C=6` on one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
- The parent commits are #4367, #4368, #4369 and #4374. This pull request adds `research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c6` and replays those predecessors.
